CREATE TABLE `restaurant_holidays` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,

  `titleAr` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `titleEn` varchar(255),
  `date` varchar(10) NOT NULL,
  `isFullDayClosed` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  `openTime` varchar(5),

  INDEX `idx_holidays_date` (`date`)
